data.display_address: Kensington Waters, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Kensington Waters is a premium project from Ellington Properties, located in MBR City. The complex consists of two towers of medium height, 12 floors each. For sale are elegant studios and apartments with 1-3 bedrooms.

The main feature of the facade is the lighting elements that make the towers look stylish and elegant. The interiors use high-quality finishing materials and equipment to create a cozy and functional environment.

Kensington Waters has a wide range of amenities, including a fitness center with panoramic windows, children's playgrounds, a spa and yoga studio, a swimming pool with a luxury terrace for relaxation.

The residential complex has a convenient location and convenient transport links, so you can reach the Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa in about 10 minutes, and the road to Dubai International Airport takes about 15 minutes.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
